topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: I can't believe this. After all the effort, all the nights poring over research, sleeping with stacks of books for pillows, they have the audacity to suggest I'd just swipe someone else's work. Have they read my other assignments? Do they know the lengths I go to, the pain I feel when I hit a wall, when I doubt every word I write? To say I plagiarized is a slap in the face, a total dismissal of the struggle and the triumph of crafting something genuinely mine. How dare they? I’ve got a bone to pick with whoever made this accusation.
